map.输入平均风速和阵风风速，按蒲福风级（Beaufort Scale）判定风力等级，: Enter the mean wind speed and gust wind speed to determine the wind force on the Beaufort scale, compute the gust factor and assess the degree of gale impact.
map.📖 查看「大风影响评估 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Gale Impact Assessment User Guide"
map.大风影响评估以平均风速与阵风风速代入蒲福风级（风速与等级的非线性查表），阵风等级: Gale impact assessment feeds the mean wind speed and gust wind speed into the Beaufort scale (a nonlinear lookup between wind speed and force); the gust level gives the warning level; the gust factor = gust ÷ mean wind, and the larger it is the more pronounced the structural wind vibration and the higher the risk to billboards, tower cranes, street trees and work at height, so reinforcement and shutdown measures must be implemented according to the level.
map.💡 蒲福风级按风速范围划分0-12级；阵风系数 G = Vg / V̄，反映湍流: 💡 The Beaufort scale divides wind force into levels 0-12 by wind speed range; the gust factor G = Vg / V̄ reflects turbulence intensity; the gale warning follows the level corresponding to the gust wind speed.
map.蒲福风级（Beaufort Scale）是国际通用的风力等级标准，0级无风至12: The Beaufort scale is the internationally used wind force standard, from level 0 calm to level 12 hurricane
map.阵风系数通常在1.2-2.0之间，越大表示湍流越强: The gust factor is usually between 1.2 and 2.0; the larger it is the stronger the turbulence
map.大风蓝色预警：阵风≥17.2m/s(8级)；黄色：≥24.5m/s(10级)；橙: Gale blue warning: gust ≥17.2 m/s (force 8); yellow: ≥24.5 m/s (force 10); orange: ≥28.5 m/s (force 11); red: ≥32.7 m/s (force 12)
map.由平均风与阵风定: Determined by mean wind and gust
map.评估大风对设施农业、广告牌、行道树的破坏。: Assess gale damage to protected agriculture, billboards and street trees.
map.给应急响应定停课停工阈值。: Set school and work suspension thresholds for emergency response.
map.平均风速 15 m/s → 7 级（劲风，全树摇动）；阵风 25 m/s → 1: Mean wind speed 15 m/s → force 7 (near gale, whole trees in motion); gust 25 m/s → force 10 (storm), which can tear off billboards; reinforce them.
map.阵风达 8 级(≥17.2 m/s)预警、10 级(≥24.5 m/s)建议停课: A gust reaching force 8 (≥17.2 m/s) triggers a warning and force 10 (≥24.5 m/s) a school-suspension recommendation; in this example a gust of 25 m/s triggers the suspension recommendation.
map.看平均风还是阵风？: Look at mean or gust wind?
map.灾害评估看阵风（瞬时极大值），建筑抗风设计取阵风；平均风用于整体评级。: Disaster assessment looks at the gust (instantaneous maximum) and building wind design uses the gust; the mean wind is used for overall rating.
map.几级风停课？: At what wind force do schools close?
map.各地不同，常见阵风 8–9 级黄色、10–11 级橙色停课，以本地预警为准。: It varies by region; commonly force 8-9 gusts are yellow and force 10-11 are orange with school suspension, subject to local warnings.
map.大风影响评估工具依据蒲福风级（Beaufort Scale）标准，输入平均风速和: Based on the Beaufort scale, the gale impact assessment tool takes the mean wind speed and gust wind speed, automatically determines the wind force, computes the gust factor, and maps the gust intensity to the gale warning level, giving descriptions of land impact and sea state.
map.阵风系数与湍流强度评估: Gust factor and turbulence intensity assessment
map.陆地影响与海面状况描述: Land impact and sea state description
